title: 第5章 下雨会往家里跑第6章 三灾七劫八难
lines: 追着荧光，乐临清御使着飞剑再度离开了宛歧镇，又一头扎入了山野中。
夜风呼啸，树影婆娑，荧光在幽暗的山林间飘忽，最终彻底消散在墨色山坳里。
这表明着对方在此地便将气息隔绝，道术已经无法继续追踪下去。
但以陈大鹏的性格，若是早有准备，早就应该遮掩气息了，而不是等到现在才突然消失，这其中必然有诈！
乐临清眸光一凝，警惕地维持着飞剑高度，没有贸然下降，朝着下方幽暗的林中甩出了一张符箓。
符箓在离地三十米的上空绽放出了一阵青光，如一轮满月，瞬间驱散了林间的阴暗。
两道异样的气息也在青光中突显而出，无处遁形。
就在这时，一道长鞭也从下方偷袭打来，如同蛰伏的毒蛇悄然发难！
许平秋只能模糊的看见一道阴影飞速的上升，随后便感觉身体一轻，耳边风声呼啸，被乐临清给抛了出去。
紧接着纸鹤在他的身下放大，将他身体承载住，一枚玉佩也抛着弧线被乐临清丢来，他匆忙接住。
玉佩通体碧绿，散发着柔和光晕，上面似乎蕴含有灵力，是用于护身的玩意。
乐临清身形则不升反降，右手一招，将金纹长剑握在手中，双眼再度泛起金焱，圣洁威严，一种炙热汇聚于剑身之上。
袭来的长鞭在半空陡然倒转，似是察觉到这柄剑非同凡响，没有硬碰硬的念头，但一道金光已经划破夜幕斩来。
只听咔嚓一声，像是琉璃破碎，但又好似金戈交击，剑光径直的斩在了长鞭之上，差点将其斩断。
随后金光化作流火，缠燃于长鞭之上，并且还在逆燃而上，如同在天地间点燃了一根曜目的火绳，想要顺势烧灼执鞭者。
长鞭再度于半空中横抽，速度极快，直接发出了音爆之声。
执鞭之人似乎打算将火焰抽灭，但乐临清的金焱并非凡火，不仅没有熄灭，反倒令火焰更旺，直到一层氤氲粉雾覆盖在长鞭之上，才将火焰浇灭。
“好你一个乐临清，看我等下如何炮制你！”
一道尖锐的女声从下方传来，显得有些气急败坏。
许平秋眯着眼，顺着声音的来源看去，只见下方的林中不知何时出现了两道身影。
刚刚开口的女子虽然声音尖锐刺耳，有种夹了杠铃的感觉，不及乐临清嗓音半分好听。
但她的姿态倒是极其优雅妩媚，尤其是身上的衣物十分大胆清凉，薄纱半遮半掩，欲露不露的感觉十分诱惑。
许平秋感觉这人可能也是和陈大朋一样，是侥幸失鸡的选手，毕竟只有男人才更懂男人想看什么。
而在她身旁的陈大朋则显然还没有适应性别的转变，身上虽然被迫穿上了一身性感的衣裙，但站姿僵硬且偏向男性，含胸驼背的，反倒是显得有些猥琐。
乐临清没有回话，而是左手再度甩出数张符箓，剑身再度泛起金光，凌空再度向着地面斩去几道剑气。
但树林之中陡然升起一阵不正经的桃粉色雾气，将陈大鹏和另外一人的身形隐匿。
金光与符箓在粉雾中绽放出光华，但似乎并没有伤到她们，反倒是粉雾以极快的速度向着乐临清蔓延，意欲将她包裹在其中。
当即，许平秋就感觉到纸鹤加速向着一个方向飞去。
乐临清挽着长剑，再度劈砍出一道道煌煌剑光，于空中炸裂成漫天焰火，用于阻碍粉雾片刻，身形也御剑遁走。
追上纸鹤后，乐临清将许平秋吸附到长剑之上，又将纸鹤收起，速度快上了不少。
content_en:
Chasing the fluorescent light, Le Linqing used his flying sword to leave Wanqi Town again and plunged into the mountains.
The night wind howled, the shadows of the trees danced, and the fluorescent light flickered in the dark mountains and forests, and finally completely dissipated in the dark mountain col.
This shows that the opponent has cut off his breath here, and Taoism can no longer track him.
But with Chen Dapeng's character, if he had been prepared, he would have covered up his aura long ago, instead of waiting until now to suddenly disappear. There must be fraud in this!
Le Linqing's eyes narrowed, and he vigilantly maintained the height of the flying sword without descending hastily, and threw a talisman toward the dark forest below.
The talisman bloomed with a burst of green light thirty meters above the ground, like a full moon, instantly dispelling the darkness in the forest.
Two strange auras also stood out in the green light, with nowhere to hide.
At this moment, a long whip struck from below, like a dormant poisonous snake quietly attacking!
Xu Pingqiu could only vaguely see a shadow rising rapidly, and then he felt his body lighten, the wind whistling in his ears, and he was thrown away by Le Linqing.
Then the paper crane enlarged under him and held his body, and a jade pendant was also thrown in an arc by Le Linqing, who hurriedly caught it.
The jade pendant is green in color and exudes a soft halo. It seems to contain spiritual power and is used for body protection.
Le Linqing's figure did not rise but fell instead. With a move of his right hand, he held the golden sword in his hand. His eyes once again glowed with golden flames, holy and majestic, and a kind of hot heat gathered on the sword body.
The long whip that was coming suddenly reversed in mid-air, as if he realized that this sword was extraordinary and had no intention of confronting him head-on, but a golden light had already cut through the night and struck.
There was just a click, like broken glass, but also like a clash of swords. The sword light struck directly on the long whip, almost cutting it off.
Then the golden light turned into flowing fire, entangled on the long whip, and was still burning upwards, like a blinding match ignited between heaven and earth, trying to burn the whip holder.
The long whip whipped across the air again, very fast, making a sonic boom sound.
The person holding the whip seemed to intend to extinguish the flame, but Le Linqing's Jin Yan was not an extraordinary fire. Not only did it not extinguish it, it actually made the flame stronger. It was not until a layer of dense powder mist covered the whip that the flame was extinguished.
"Okay, Le Linqing, let's see how I deal with you later!"
A sharp female voice came from below, looking a little angry.
Xu Pingqiu squinted and looked towards the source of the sound, only to see two figures appearing in the forest below.
Although the voice of the woman who just spoke was sharp and harsh, as if she had a barbell clamped on her, it was not half as good as Le Linqing's voice.
But her posture is extremely elegant and charming, especially the clothes on her body are very bold and cool, half covered by tulle, and the feeling of being naked is very tempting.
Xu Pingqiu felt that this man might be the same as Chen Dapeng, a lucky player. After all, only men know better what men want to see.
Chen Dapeng, who was beside her, had obviously not adapted to the gender change. Although he was forced to wear a sexy dress, his posture was stiff and masculine, with his breasts covered and his back hunched over, which made him look a bit vulgar.
Le Linqing did not reply, but threw out several talismans with his left hand. The sword body once again glowed with golden light, and he slashed several sword energy towards the ground in the air.
But an irregular peach-pink mist suddenly rose in the woods, hiding the figures of Chen Dapeng and the other person.
The golden light and talismans bloomed in the pink mist, but it did not seem to hurt them. On the contrary, the pink mist spread towards Le Linqing at an extremely fast speed, intending to wrap her in it.
Immediately, Xu Pingqiu felt the paper crane speeding up and flying in one direction.
Le Linqing held his long sword and slashed out streaks of brilliant sword light again, which exploded into fireworks all over the sky. They blocked the powder mist for a moment, and he escaped with his sword.
After catching up with the paper crane, Le Linqing attached Xu Pingqiu to the long sword, then put the paper crane away, and his speed became much faster.
